description: Overrides ONLY — the classification, cooldown and labels live in homelab's .github/renovate-global.json (applied to every repo; `extends`/`:dependencyDashboard` here were overridden by its `force` block anyway). Renovate here covers THIS repo's own third-party dependencies: GitHub Actions and the snore-recorder deploy runner image. The first-party pins (sleep-ingester chart/image, SNORE_IMAGE) are NOT Renovate's: the app repos' deploy-pin PRs move them (homelab docs/sleep-iac.md §Deploy pipeline), keyed on git sha, which Renovate can't order — the global ghcr.io/teststuffstash/** rule disables them.

kubernetes.description: The global `kubernetes` pattern is homelab's argocd/resources only, so the snore-recorder deploy Job/CronJob runner image (alpine/ansible) was never extracted. Appended to the global pattern; every per-stack manifest directory here.

packageRules.description: The deploy runner image is pinned by digest as well as tag (the `# renovate: pin digest` intent on both manifests) — the hook and the nightly CronJob must run the identical image. The global digest rule takes the pin PR (automerge); tag patch/minor ride the global kubernetes deps-review lane.
